files.cluster_markers.py:
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc

adata = sc.read_csv("stroma_counts.csv")
meta = pd.read_csv("stroma_clusters.csv", index_col=0)
adata.obs["cluster"] = pd.Categorical(meta.loc[adata.obs_names, "cluster"].astype(str).values)
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)

sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(adata, "cluster", groups=["1", "2"], method="t-test")
sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(adata, group="1").to_csv("cluster1_vs_cluster2.csv", index=False)
